reviewer: Internal engineering/research protocol; not independent biological certification
scope: Candidate-independent Human functional pharmacology; stop before the held-out challenge molecule is evaluated

universe_selection.rule: Union of every enumerated target in the March 2026 Reaction Biology general InVEST/PDE/CYP panel tables and the already-frozen general primary safety-panel table; no candidate-based additions
universe_selection.ambiguous_complexes_and_isoforms: Keep visible; do not pretend a single protein or unspecified isoform is an exact functional assay target

functional_data.source: Projected ChEMBL direct Human target identity, compound graph, assay metadata and quantitative activity records
functional_data.oversize_policy: Unsupported rather than a truncated or favorable sample
functional_data.assay_conditions: Retain exact assay IDs, descriptions, host, BAO, source hashes and protocol heterogeneity; unknown pH, temperature, substrate/ATP and free concentration are not invented
functional_data.concentration_basis: Assay nominal unless exact original evidence supports measured free concentration or a separately reviewed explicit conversion

leakage_firewall.numeric_requests: Explicit admitted molecule AND assay identifier sets only, after compound-parent/fragment/connectivity and assay-semantic checks
leakage_firewall.heldout_exclusion: Offline challenge identity used only to deny exact parents, salts, normalized connectivity, tautomers and exact records; never used for a functional query, target selection, inference or labels
leakage_firewall.development_controls: Also excluded from every train/calibration/test partition before unrelated end-to-end validation
leakage_firewall.nearby_analogs: Allowed if not an exact normalized parent/connectivity match; report nearest training Morgan similarity and scaffold-held-out performance
leakage_firewall.unexpected_response: Quarantine and fail the response before labels enter training or inference; no unsafe payload is saved as an admitted source

training.architecture: Morgan radius-2 512-bit fingerprints plus the existing eight RDKit descriptors; fixed random forest baseline
training.split: Graph-deduplicated nonchiral Murcko-scaffold hash buckets: train 0..69, calibration 70..84, test 85..99
training.replicates: Median negative-log molar potency within one exact endpoint/action/readout stratum; retain all original rows and source IDs
training.hyperparameter_selection: No post-test tuning or favorable model selection; a failed baseline stays unsupported
training.calibration: 90% marginal split-conformal absolute residual interval in endpoint-specific negative-log molar space
training.domain_threshold: Maximum of 0.4 and calibration nearest-neighbor tenth percentile, plus all training descriptor ranges; weakly supported does not count as in-domain
training.exact_training_overlap: Refuse independent prediction; no apparent validation on a training graph

gate.rationale: Predeclared internal screening gate in log10-molar units, not a clinical error tolerance. MAE 0.6 is approximately four-fold concentration error; RMSE, ranking, finite-sample coverage and in-domain sample size must also pass
limitations: Conditional assay potency, not proof of activity
90% marginal calibration is not a joint exposure/activity interval or guaranteed conditional-domain coverage
Assay/protocol heterogeneity and censoring exclusion remain disclosed
No gate may be weakened in response to coverage or the held-out candidate

roles: Sourced ion-channel-block positive control and existing exploratory native current model
Weak/negative response retained only if actually supported by the source
unrelated_acceptance.negative_case_rule: An unsupported or subthreshold calculation is not a negative experimental finding

required: potency interval or explicit unquantified measurement uncertainty
exposure_activity.percent_or_ac50: Not relabelled as IC50/EC50; no dose-response or physiological transfer without an independent qualified contract
exposure_activity.nominal_free_conversion: No automatic conversion; exact source-bound measured-free evidence or explicit reviewed assumption is required
exposure_activity.margin: Sampled unbound concentration / compatible functional potency, with independent interval bounds; not a joint probability or toxicity conclusion

physiology.interface: Reuse current model and reviewed transfer contracts
physiology.cardiac_qualification: Preserve State B exploratory_only and no independent candidate-decision authority
physiology.clinical_translation: APD90 is not QTc; no toxicity probability or clinical qualification

research_assessment.concern_scope: Exposure-relevant research mechanism warranting investigation, not toxicity proof
necessary_gates: Compatible unbound exposure overlaps the functional range
Uncertainty does not eliminate the finding
research_assessment.rule_source: Exact reviewed general mechanism evidence, never candidate-specific history

freeze_and_stop: Leave source changes uncommitted; stop after unrelated numerical/browser/regression/leakage validation. No held-out rerun, dossier revision, commit or push is authorized in this milestone
